name: Guyana

bbox_source.dataset: Guyana - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB), admin level 0
bbox_source.publisher: OCHA Field Information Services Section (source: DEVInfo LAC project)
bbox_source.method: Shapefile header of guy_admbnd_adm0_2021 (WGS 84). regions.box() adds the 0.15 degree margin the US state maps use.

includes: Streets, buildings, terrain, land cover, water, help points, place names, postcode areas and the house addresses mapped in OpenStreetMap (about 1,200, mostly in Georgetown, Rosignol and Belle West) for Guyana. Address search covers only those: there is no complete open list of addresses for Guyana yet.

streets.dataset: OpenStreetMap roads, land use, waterways and named places (Geofabrik Guyana extract, free GeoPackage)
streets.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Data available under the Open Database License (ODbL).

pois.dataset: OpenStreetMap points of interest, the classes in tools/build_map.py POI_KEEP
pois.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Data available under the Open Database License (ODbL).

water.dataset: OpenStreetMap water areas (lakes, reservoirs, rivers, wetlands)
water.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Data available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
water.note: No open dam inventory for Guyana was found, so there are no dam points.

terrain.dataset: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Copernicus WorldDEM-30), via the Copernicus DEM open data bucket
terrain.publisher: European Space Agency / Airbus Defence and Space
terrain.attribution: Produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved. The organisations in charge of the Copernicus programme by law or by delegation do not incur any liability for any use of the Copernicus WorldDEM-30.
terrain.note: A surface model: in forest, relief and contour lines follow the tree tops, not the ground.

crops.dataset: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200, cropland class
crops.attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
crops.note: Land cover, not crop types: it shows where cropland is, not what grows there.

buildings.attribution: Building footprints © Microsoft, Global ML Building Footprints, under the Community Data License Agreement - Permissive 2.0.
buildings.note: Microsoft's README names CDLA Permissive 2.0; Overture's attribution page lists the same dataset under ODbL. Confirm which applies before publishing.

places.dataset: OpenStreetMap named places and named points of interest
places.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Data available under the Open Database License (ODbL).

places.dataset: Guyana COD-AB admin levels 1 and 2 (10 regions, 27 sub-regions)
places.publisher: OCHA Field Information Services Section (source: DEVInfo LAC project)
places.attribution: Administrative regions: OCHA, Guyana COD-AB (source: DEVInfo LAC project), CC BY-IGO.

places.dataset: GeoNames GY.zip, populated places (feature class P) that OpenStreetMap lacks, e.g. Georgetown neighbourhoods (PPLX)

GuyNode Guyana Place Name Registry: its 'Gazetteer' and 'GuyNode POI seed' rows (packaging/regions/GY-guynode-places.csv, taken 2026-11-23), only where OpenStreetMap and GeoNames have no place of that name within 5 km
places.note: guynode.com states no licence for the registry; its data policy offers GuyNode's own layers 'for educational and research use'. Positions are rounded to the nearest minute (about 1.8 km). Kept in its own file so it can be dropped.
places.attribution: Place names: GuyNode Guyana Place Name Registry (guynode.com), no known licence.

places.dataset: Guyana postcode directory (region, sub-region, area, street, post office, 7-digit postcode), copied to packaging/regions/GY-postcodes.csv on 2026-11-23: 2,201 rows, 227 postcodes
places.attribution: Postcodes: Guyana Post Office Corporation, https://guypost.gy/search-postcode/.
places.note: Not open data: this is government-provided information published by the Guyana Post Office Corporation, with no licence or reuse terms on guypost.gy (footer: "Guyana Post Office Corporation © 2020"). It is kept in its own file and rows (source 'Guyana Post Office Corporation') so it can be dropped if reuse is not allowed.
places.method: The directory has no coordinates. Each area and postcode is put at an OpenStreetMap place with the area's name within 25 km of its post office, else at the post office (an OSM post office or a place with the office's name). Areas whose office and name can't be found are left out.

addresses.dataset: OpenStreetMap house addresses (addr:housenumber and addr:street), Geofabrik Guyana full extract (guyana-latest.osm.pbf)
addresses.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Data available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
addresses.method: Every OSM node or way with addr:housenumber and addr:street, written in tools/build_addresses.py's addr table (state 'GY'). An address without addr:city takes the nearest town, village or neighbourhood within 5 km.

address.postcode: Guyana has 7-digit postcodes (region, locality, district, post office, sub-locality; Guyana Post Office Corporation and the UPU addressing sheet of August 2025). GPOC's directory is included as places (kind 'postcode', e.g. 'Danielstown 2210201'), found by area name or code and placed at the area or its post office. It is government-provided, not open data: see sources.places.
address.postcode_note: Not open data: this is government-provided information published by the Guyana Post Office Corporation, with no licence or reuse terms on guypost.gy (footer: "Guyana Post Office Corporation © 2020"). It is kept in its own file and rows (source 'Guyana Post Office Corporation') so it can be dropped if reuse is not allowed.
address.coverage: OpenStreetMap addresses only (about 1,200 on 2026-11-23). GLSC holds the authoritative address and parcel data, which is not open; GuyNode's place registry and geocoder state no licence, and Google, GeoPostcodes and similar are paid or forbid storing results, so none of those are used.
address.engine_note: engine/address_search.py labels every address result 'Overture Maps'; GY addresses come from OpenStreetMap, so the label needs to come from the index's meta 'source'.
